# Vendored terminal renderer

- `@xterm/xterm` 6.0.0: `xterm.js`, `xterm.css`, `xterm-LICENSE`.
- `@xterm/addon-fit` 0.11.0: `addon-fit.js`, `addon-fit-LICENSE`.

Obtained from the official npm packages, without local modifications. Their MIT licenses are included. Files are bundled locally; the app does not load JavaScript or styles from a CDN. There is no Node.js runtime in the app.
